text: My uncle says burning the refuse heap is the cleanest way to clear it.
The World Health Organization says burning waste releases air pollutants. Some harm both our health and the climate.
Breathing the smoke can cause coughing, skin irritation and breathing problems.
Ehn? So wetin we go do?
Bag it. Keep it covered until it's collected. And keep plastics, tyres and nylon out of any fire.
